packages.story: The north of the Eifel: the Rur winding through wooded valleys, the Rursee behind its dams, Monschau's half-timbered houses deep in their gorge, and long climbs out of every valley onto the open plateau of the national park around Vogelsang. Quiet roads, steep valley sides, and a view at the top of most climbs.
packages.summary: Loops from under an hour to an afternoon, eight hill repeats from one minute to eight, and three VO₂max roads, all on the Eifel's own roads, read to the metre on NRW's laser survey.
packages.tagline: The Rursee, Monschau and the high plateau
